    StartersFlint coney dogsGrilled hot dogs with spiced beef chilli sauce, mustard and onionHow to make it300g beef mince1 jar chilli powder1 jar ground cumin1 jar smoked paprika8 frankfurts8 hot dog buns1 jar American mustard1 onion60ml waterBrown the beef mince until very fine and dry, then add the chilli powder, the cumin, the paprika and the water and cook 10 minutes.Grill the frankfurts and put in the hot dog buns with mustard, the coney sauce and diced onion.Flint Tropics coconut prawnsCoconut crumbed prawns, fried golden, with mango chilli sauceHow to make it600g green king prawns50g plain flour2 eggs60g desiccated coconut60g panko crumbs1 L vegetable oil1 mango3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce1 lime1 red chilliPeel the green king prawns, leaving tails on.Dust in the plain flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then press into the desiccated coconut mixed with the panko.Fry in oil at 180°C for 2 minutes until golden and drain.Simmer the flesh of the mango with the sweet chilli sauce, the juice of the lime and the chopped red chilli for 3 minutes, then blitz smooth.Serve the prawns hot with the sauce.MainsJackie Moon's barbecue pork ribsSlow-baked ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, buttered corn and slawHow to make it1.5kg pork ribs1 jar smoked paprika250ml barbecue sauce4 corn cobs30g butter1 bag coleslaw mix4 tbsp mayonnaiseRub the pork ribs with salt, pepper and smoked paprika, wrap in foil and bake at 160°C for 2 hours.Unwrap, brush with the barbecue sauce and grill until sticky.Boil the corn cobs and toss in the butter. Serve with the ribs and the coleslaw mixed with mayonnaise.Let's get Tropical teriyaki chicken skewersGrilled thigh and pineapple, sticky teriyaki. Everybody love everybodyHow to make it700g chicken thigh fillets, cubed1/2 pineapple, cut in chunks100ml teriyaki sauce1 tbsp sesame seeds3 spring onions, sliced300g jasmine rice8 skewersThread the chicken and pineapple onto skewers and coat in half the teriyaki.Rinse the rice and simmer it, covered, until the water is gone. Rest it with the lid on.Grill the skewers, turning and brushing with the rest of the teriyaki, until charred and cooked through.Serve on the rice with sesame and spring onion.SweetsSeventies orange and cream cakeOrange butter cake with mascarpone cream and orange glazeHow to make it200g butter200g caster sugar4 eggs3 oranges200g self-raising flour250g mascarpone200ml thickened cream120g icing sugarvanilla extract, to tasteHeat the oven to 180°C.Beat the butter and the caster sugar, add the eggs one at a time and the zest of the oranges, then fold in the self-raising flour and the orange juice.Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake 25 minutes.Cool.Whip the mascarpone, the cream, the icing sugar and the vanilla.Sandwich and top the cakes with the cream and drizzle over the icing sugar mixed with the orange juice.DrinksCoffee Black's espresso martiniVodka, coffee liqueur and espresso shaken until foamyHow to make it180ml vodka120ml coffee liqueurespresso coffee beans, to taste40ml brown sugar syrup1 orange2 cups iceChill the coupes.Pull the shots of espresso and cool 5 minutes.For each drink, shake the vodka, the coffee liqueur, the espresso and the brown sugar syrup with lots of ice for 15 seconds until foamy.Strain into the glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.For non-drinkers, shake the espresso with syrup, milk and ice instead.Harvey WallbangerEverybody love everybody.
